# Markham Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Markham. Furnace repair covers diagnosing and correcting faults in gas, propane, or oil forced-air furnaces, including ignition, airflow, control, and heat-exchanger concerns.

Email: contact@markhamheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://markhamheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Markham, Richmond Hill, Newmarket, Aurora, Vaughan, Keswick, Stouffville, King City. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
